pairing.heading: Pairing systems
pairing.intro: Different tournaments use different systems to decide who plays whom each round.
pairing.swiss: Swiss — each round pairs players with the closest scores who have not yet met, without repeating a pairing; the tournament ends after a fixed number of rounds without a single winner emerging from a full round-robin.
pairing.roundRobin: Round-robin — every player meets every other player once (or twice, in a double round-robin), so the final standings reflect complete head-to-head results.
pairing.olympic: Olympic — a single-elimination bracket: the loser of each match is eliminated, and the winner advances until one player remains.
pairing.teamMatch: Team-match — teams of players face off board by board; each board's result (win/draw/loss) contributes to the team's overall match score.

tieBreaks.heading: Tie-breaks
tieBreaks.intro: When two or more players finish with the same number of points, one or more of the following criteria — in the order the organizer chose for this tournament (see the Info tab) — decide the final ranking.
tieBreaks.points: Points — the player's own total score; included as a possible tie-break for completeness.
tieBreaks.directEncounter: Direct encounter — the result(s) of the game(s) played against opponents who finished on the same number of points.
tieBreaks.winCount: Number of wins — how many games the player won outright.
tieBreaks.buchholz: Buchholz — the sum of the final scores of all of the player's opponents.
tieBreaks.berger: Sonneborn-Berger — the sum of the scores of the opponents the player beat, plus half the score of every opponent the player drew.
tieBreaks.buchholzCut1: Buchholz Cut 1 — Buchholz with the single lowest-scoring opponent's result removed.
tieBreaks.buchholzCut2: Buchholz Cut 2 — Buchholz with the two lowest-scoring opponents' results removed.
tieBreaks.medianBuchholz: Median Buchholz — Buchholz with both the highest- and lowest-scoring opponents' results removed.
tieBreaks.cumulativeScore: Cumulative score — the player's running total after each round, added up; rewards a player who led early over one who caught up at the end.

rating.heading: Rating formula
rating.intro: Ratings are updated after a tournament is finalized, using the standard Elo formula.
rating.formula: expected = 1 / (1 + 10^((opponentRating − ownRating) / 400));  newRating = oldRating + K × (actualScore − expected), with K = 20.
rating.notes: Matches are processed one at a time in order, so each player's rating is updated after every game before the next game is calculated — later results in the same tournament use the already-updated rating. Byes and games without a recorded result are skipped.
